content.short: Lightweight WebSockets bridge for cardano-node, enabling local clients to interact with Ouroboros mini-protocols.
content.description: Ogmios is a streamlined, lightweight WebSocket bridge for the Cardano blockchain, enabling developers to access the node's Ouroboros mini-protocols through a JSON-RPC interface. Designed for performance and ease of integration, Ogmios supports key functionalities like chain synchronization, transaction submission, ledger state queries, and mempool monitoring. Its efficient WebSocket-based communication ensures real-time, bidirectional messaging, making it an excellent choice for applications that require high-speed interactions with Cardano's ecosystem.
content.meta: Find out about Ogmios on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions.
